lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately three horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs positioned posterior to the branchial region, with the median row displaying the most regular inter-blob spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges extending across the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance circular clusters located primarily on the basal and mid-posterior sections of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, linear appendage or mark trailing posteriorly from the lower trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; multiple dark fusiform silhouettes (consistent with remoras) are attached near the gill slits and pectoral fin base.
